proposals.evidence: DEDR990(b) explicitly gives Gadaba ukuṭ/okuṭ one thing. Preserve the original same/whole glosses; the current *okk- parent matches this subgroup. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
